insight.headline: KEP-09 breaks NHR's line with a 25.2 m pass in the 76th minute
insight.why_it_matters: The moment matters because it shows KEP's progression through NHR's midfield block rather than around it: KEP-09 receives on the right side and plays a 25.2 m pass forward into a line-broken position at high technical difficulty, and NHR's immediate attempt to slow the sequence ends with a lost tackle. A completed line break there moves the ball into the zone where the defending side's second line is stretched, which is why it carries a measurable threat gain rather than being a neutral circulation pass.
insight.watch_next: Watch item (not a finding): whether NHR adjusts the spacing of its second line after e-001028 was logged as a lost tackle, since KEP-02 was able to carry 11.0 m from the reception point at 76:13.

claims.text: At 76:04 KEP-09 completed a line-breaking pass to KEP-06 that covered 25.2 m with a recorded pass difficulty of 6.1 while under an event pressure of 0.51.
The completed line break produced an xt_delta of 0.118 threat units, the threat gain logged for this pass.
The break arrived at the end of a KEP sequence in which KEP-11 completed a 9.8 m pass under pressure of 0.94 at 75:51 and KEP-04 then completed a 24.0 m pass at pressure of 0.08 at 75:58.
NHR did not stop the progression: NHR-11's tackle at 76:08 was recorded as lost and KEP-02 followed with an 11.0 m carry to x 87.6 under pressure of 0.7.
The snapshot's line_breaks count of 8.0 includes e-001027, placing this completion among the line breaks recorded in this match.

La secuencia previa: KEP-11 pasó 9,8 m bajo presión 0,94 (75:51) y KEP-04 pasó 24,0 m con presión 0,08 (75:58). fan_cards.watch_next: Observar si NHR ajusta el espaciado de su segunda línea tras el tackle perdido de e-001028, dado que KEP-02 pudo acarrear 11,0 m desde la recepción en 76:13.

fan_cards.headline: KEP-09第76分钟25.2米穿透传球撕开NHR防线
fan_cards.what_happened: 第76分04秒，KEP-09在事件压力0.51下完成一记难度6.1、距离25.2米的向前传球，找到KEP-06并形成穿透防线。该传球记录xt_delta为0.118。此前KEP-11在75:51于0.94压力下完成9.8米传球，KEP-04在75:58以0.08压力完成24.0米传球。随后NHR-11在76:08的抢断被记为失败，KEP-02于76:13带球11.0米至x=87.6、压力0.7。
fan_cards.why_it_matters: 这次穿透发生在NHR中场防线内部而非外侧，球进入防守第二线被拉伸的区域，因此其威胁增益可量化，不是中性倒脚；该场line_breaks计数8.0也包含此次完成。
fan_cards.watch_next: 观察NHR在e-001028记为失败抢断后是否调整第二线间距，因为KEP-02在76:13从接球点带球11.0米。

fan_cards.headline: KEP-09 threads a 25.2 m pass straight through NHR's line
fan_cards.what_happened: KEP-09 picked up the ball on the right and slid a 25.2 m pass forward right through NHR's midfield line, like finding a gap in a fence instead of walking around it. NHR tried to slow things down, but the tackle was lost and KEP kept rolling.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: Breaking the line pushes the ball into the space where NHR's second line gets stretched, so it's a real step forward, not just a safe sideways knock.
fan_cards.watch_next: Keep an eye on whether NHR tightens the spacing of its second line, since KEP-02 carried the ball 11.0 m right after.
fan_cards.how_we_know: The pass, its 25.2 m distance and 6.1 difficulty, the 0.118 threat gain, and the lost NHR tackle are all logged as events e-001027, e-001025, e-001026, e-001028 and e-001029.

fan_cards.headline: KEP-09 rompe la barrera de NHR con un pase largo
fan_cards.what_happened: En el minuto 76, KEP-09 recibió por la derecha y metió un pase largo hacia adelante que atravesó la barrera del mediocampo de NHR. El rival intentó frenar la jugada, pero no pudo.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: Ese pase dejó al ataque en la zona donde la defensa queda estirada y con menos ayuda. No fue un pase cualquiera.
fan_cards.watch_next: Queda por ver si NHR ajusta el espaciado de su segunda línea después de que su intento de quite terminara en balón perdido.
fan_cards.how_we_know: Los datos de los eventos e-001027, e-001028 y e-001029 registran el pase completado y el intento fallido de NHR por detener la jugada.

fan_cards.watch_next: 观察NHR是否调整第二线间距，因为e-001028已被记为失败抢断，而KEP-02在76:13从接球点带出11.0米。
fan_cards.how_we_know: 以上判断基于e-001027记录的25.2米传球、0.51事件压迫和6.1传球难度，以及e-001028、e-001029记录的失败抢断与后续带球推进。
